correctness.rationale: For all positive m,n, induced norm is maximum matrix entry, hence extreme contractions are sign matrices. Independent sign vectors express every norm-one rank-one uv^T as convex sum of rank-one sign matrices. For each 2<=r<=min(m,n), the explicit two sign vertices S,S' differ in exactly one entry and have ranks r−1 and r; their strict edge interior stays rank r. All other saturated coordinates force any extreme-point decomposition to use both endpoints, including lower rank S. This is a universal proof with 273+64 exact rational corroborating cases, not an extrapolation from computation.

value.rationale: A natural exact complete rank-spectrum classification for a two-parameter family studied explicitly in the 2022 operator-geometry literature. It answers the motivated rank-restricted convexification problem at every admissible order, giving a constructive rank-one decomposition and sharp exposed-edge obstructions for all higher ranks; distinct from routine vertex counting or a single low-dimensional example.
